fieldValues.title: Make meaning: name the problem in its domain
fieldValues.purpose: Work starts from meaning: a problem in a domain, held by a persona, in words that trace back to the experience they came from.
fieldValues.in_scope: Domains, personas, problems, clusters, tensions and poles; suggestions and their affirmed forks; deriving records from vignettes.
fieldValues.out_of_scope: Choosing and ranking the response (Choose a response).
